steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic project configuration and package namespace for com.retrocarracer.app.

steps.title: Setup Android Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the root build.gradle and the app-level build.gradle with strict Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2 specifications, enabling Java 8 source/target compatibility.

steps.title: Define Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml under the com.retrocarracer.app package, specifying portrait orientation and full-screen material theme behavior without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Design Main Layout XML
steps.description: Establish the XML layout with the custom GameView placeholder, control buttons, scoring dashboard, and overlay container layouts for the Start and Game Over screens.

steps.title: Create Sound and Haptics Helper
steps.description: Construct simple sound effect generation utility classes using the Android SDK SoundPool or ToneGenerator to simulate retro engine noises and crash sound alerts.

steps.title: Design Game Entities
steps.description: Create data modeling structures and rendering definitions for obstacles (enemy cars, oil slicks) and collectible items (gold coins) on the scrolling roadway.

steps.title: Develop Game Canvas Rendering Engine
steps.description: Implement the core 2D graphics render pipeline inside GameView.java, drawing the grass borders, asphalt road, moving lane markers, player car, and animated obstacles.

steps.title: Implement Collision Detection Logic
steps.description: Write advanced physics and bounding-box collision detection routines inside the GameView game-loop, managing safe/unsafe states and tracking score increments.

steps.title: Connect Controller Inputs
steps.description: Attach click and touch event handlers to Retro Car Racer UI controls, implementing smooth horizontal steering physics with acceleration and friction coefficients.

steps.title: Save High Scores and User Progress
steps.description: Configure SharedPreferences storage queries to persist the highest achieved retro racing score and display it directly on the main dashboard and game over screen.

steps.title: Perform Cleanups & Code Review
steps.description: Double check standard imports, remove modern Java lambda usages to maintain strict Java 8 compatibility, and verify manifest attributes.

steps.title: Building Retro Car Racer
steps.description: Compile, build, and assemble the final application packages cleanly using the unified Gradle assembler toolchain.
